description: Create, edit, rename, duplicate or delete trap presets, load them from another InDesign document, or delete every unused one (Trap Presets panel menu: New Preset, Duplicate Preset, Delete Presets, Preset Options, Load Trap Presets, Select All Unused); assign presets to pages with set_page_properties

action.description: What to do: load copies presets from fromFile; delete_unused deletes presets no page uses

fromFile.description: For load: absolute path of an InDesign document or template (.indd, .indt) to load the trap presets of

name.description: The preset name (the new name for create; the existing preset for update, duplicate and delete)

newName.description: New name (update renames; duplicate names the copy, default "<name> copy")

replaceWith.description: For delete and delete_unused: the preset pages using a deleted preset get instead

scope.description: The active document's presets, or the application defaults used by new documents

settings.description: Trap preset options (Preset Options dialog); only the ones you pass change

blackColorThreshold.description: Black ink (%) at which the black trap width applies (Trap Thresholds > Black Color) (0 to 100)

blackDensity.description: Neutral density at or above which an ink counts as black (Trap Thresholds > Black Density) (0.001 to 10)

blackWidth.description: Trap width where black is involved (Trap Width > Black) (points, 0 to 8)

colorReduction.description: How much abutting colours reduce the trap colour, % (Trap Thresholds > Trap Color Reduction) (0 to 100)

defaultTrapWidth.description: Default trap width (Trap Width > Default) (points, 0 to 8)

imagePlacement.description: Trap placement between images and objects: Center, Choke, Neutral Density or Spread (Images > Trap Placement)

imagesToImages.description: Trap images to images (Images > Trap Images to Images)

internalImages.description: Trap within images (Images > Trap Images Internally)

objectsToImages.description: Trap objects to images (Images > Trap Objects to Images)

slidingTrapThreshold.description: Density difference (%) at which a trap slides toward the centreline (Trap Thresholds > Sliding Trap) (0 to 100)

stepThreshold.description: Colour change (%) needed before a trap is made (Trap Thresholds > Step) (1 to 100)

name: manage_trap_preset
title: Manage Trap Preset
